title: Realestate.com.au Suburb Profile Scraper
description: Get a realestate.com.au suburb profile with median prices, market trends, rental yields, local areas, and source data. Batch profile URLs to compare Australian housing markets.

batch.title: Suburb profile URLs
batch.description: Full realestate.com.au suburb or market profile URLs.
batch.valueDescription: suburb profile URL used for this market lookup.

schema.description: Full realestate.com.au suburb or market profile URL.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape realestate.com.au suburb profiles with median prices, market trends, rental yields, and local area details. Batch URLs to compare housing markets.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve a realestate.com.au suburb profile by URL. The profile contains market trends, median prices, rental yields, nearby areas, and the source market data.
useCases: Investors can compare market trends and median prices across suburbs.
Buyers can review local sales and rental indicators before choosing an area.
Housing analysts can archive suburb profiles for market monitoring.
howToUse: Add a full realestate.com.au suburb profile URL to `profile_urls`.
Set `maxResults` to control how many profiles are saved in the run.
Export each profile record and inspect the nested trend series.

faqs.question: Can I use a property listing URL?
faqs.answer: No. Use a suburb or market profile URL. Property, agent, and agency URLs are handled by separate Actors.
